glossary.quarantine: Move a folder into recoverable storage. This normally does not reclaim disk space.
glossary.permanent delete: Irreversible removal of an appdata folder or an exact ZFS dataset after explicit confirmation.
glossary.purge: Permanently remove a quarantined folder; also applies when its scheduled purge time arrives.
glossary.restore: Recover a quarantined folder or saved template without silently replacing an existing destination.
glossary.Safe Mode: Quarantine-first mode for movable folders. It is not a promise that all operations are reversible.
glossary.dry run: Preview the proposed action without performing filesystem changes.
glossary.template backup: Private saved container configuration, separate from appdata and sanitized support diagnostics.
